author: reek
body: General Ledger engine. Posts balanced journal entries, maintains account balances, enforces period controls, generates trial balance and financial statements. All postings are double-entry: total debits must equal total credits or the entry is rejected.

author: reek
body: The ledger lives twice: in the working lists and balances of GlState, and written through to Codex DB tables in gl-db. Accounts, journals, journal lines, and an audit trail persist; balances are derived and replayed on rebuild. Periods and the bounded log are working state only.

author: reek
body: Periods are closed by default: a period that was never opened rejects postings. Scenario and test code must open every period it posts into.

author: reek
body: Rebuilds working state from the persisted tables: accounts from gl_accounts, balances by replaying every line in gl_journal_lines. Parent, control, and bank flags and per-line metadata are not yet persisted; the rebuild restores exactly what the trial balance and statements need. The atype column only ever holds the five names account-type-name produces; anything else reads back as Asset.
